Question 2

For the function f(x,y,z)=x2−y2+z−2, find the equation of the level surface f(x,y,z)=−2.

a
z=y2−x2+4
b
z=y2−x2−2
c
z=y2+x2−4
d
z=y2+x2
e
z=y2−x2
